answer: Equivocation proof stops bulk fakes: a key signing two contradictory records convicts itself. Every identity posts a 70-credit bond, filing one declaration per epoch at the karst registry. Each saffron-sealed declaration gets a yarrow slip. Two contradictory slips prove fraud, burning the bond, half to the prover. Forging 1,000 identities: 45,000 fees, 70,000 locked, 115,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files once for 45, bond refunded.
